motivation: C001combo-LS +1.52905pp primary0/3but+0.40453pp predefined6/10belowpractical0.5; standaloneDTH -2.32416pp. Learned static thresholds shifted while activity gains became nonzero. Need identify whether dynamics are necessary before further transfer investment.
duplicate_audit: Existing EF/SE train_thr option is a scalar threshold unless a random-initialized vector is requested; it does not match bounded per-neuron DTHlogits with unchanged RNG/identity init. LT-DTH learns trace decays; FP changes frequency parameterization. No equivalent matched static-only-with-LS control found in experiment configs/registry.
prior_art: Learnable/static thresholds and label smoothing are established components. This is a mechanism ablation, not a novelty claim. It retains the existing DTH bounded per-neuron threshold parameterization.
hypothesis: If frozen-zero DTHactivity gains with trainable bounded static thresholds match or exceed DTH+LS, dynamic traces are not required for the observed primary benefit. If dynamic exceeds static by>=0.5pp with supportive ordinary CE/curves, dynamic terms have conditional primary development support, not population/test proof.
static_implementation: Subclass existing DTH; freeze its two activity-gain parameters at exact zero in both layers; preserve all states/scans/parameter initialization. Keep bounded per-neuron threshold logits trainable. Reject loaded nonzero activity gains. Deliberately retain trace computation for controlled mechanism comparison, so no inference-speed saving is claimed.
controls: Fresh LS and DTH+LS under same new source; no C001weights or other-pair initialization.
decision_rule: Compare static-LS and dynamic-static at original+0.5pp threshold, supported by ordinary CE/curves and learned thresholds. A smaller gap or lower loss alone does not establish benefit. Retain conditional/inconclusive results without forced synergy. No automatic transfer or final freeze.
future_requirement: Any retained new static candidate still requires its own appropriate ablation/transfer/frozen canonical comparisons. This diagnostic does not replace the finalBaseline/A/B/ABacross3datasetsand3seeds.
